tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page/app background. The only surface the Cover and reference boards sit on.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panel, card, table-cell and default-input fill — Decklist/Quality panels, Manutenção category cards, DeckEditor table inputs.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces: the 'Dados' dropdown menu, the import-backup modal, every toast.

tokens.name: surface-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header background, used with backdrop-filter:blur(10px).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop, over the dimmed page content.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icon color on surface-000/100/200 — titles, input values, button labels, toast text. 17.4:1 on surface-000, 15.0:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Landing hero paragraph (the artboard's #CFC9DE). Same value as the resting nav-link grey, still written as #cfc9de in navLinkClass.ts and BackupMenu.tsx until DAL-57 moves them here. Brighter than ink-muted, dimmer than ink. 12.3:1 on surface-000, 11.8:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — page subtitles, 'Precisa: N' labels, back/remove-row icons, nav-link resting color. 7.0:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text for standalone captions — the 'PTCG Tools' eyebrow on reference boards, the dropdown chevron, a toast's close icon. 5.1:1 on surface-100 — never drop it below this weight (see ink-subtle).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Micro-labels that are never the only carrier of meaning — uppercase table-column headers (#, Carta, Tem), the 'Decks:' caption before a badge, the '/60 cartas' suffix beside a bold count, a read-only textarea's placeholder tone. 4.83:1 on surface-100 (lightened from the live site's literal #6f6a80, which reads 3.6:1 there, to clear the 4.5:1 floor — same violet-gray hue family, a step darker than ink-faint so the two tiers stay distinct). Still always pairs with a bolder value, an icon or a color-coded border, never standing alone.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default control border — text inputs, the mobile-menu button, deck-name field, ghost-button resting border.

tokens.name: border-faint
tokens.usage: Panel/card border and header/dropdown hairline dividers — quiet, structural, never a focus target.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: A ghost button's own open/active state (the 'Dados' trigger while its menu is open).

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed border on a surplus/no-op maintenance row that needs no action (Precisa: 0).

tokens.name: divider-accent
tokens.usage: The 1px internal divider inside a two-button icon button-group (Salvar | Excluir on DeckEditor) — never a neutral grey here, always the accent at half strength.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill — Converter, Salvar, the logomark's front card. Always paired with a 1.5px secondary-colored border on filled primary buttons (brand rule, not a default browser outline).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover/active.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The signature accent — active nav-link, selected pill (NM, PT/EN), focus/selection state, success state, progress-bar end stop, the logomark's back card. Carries meaning on its own only alongside a border or an icon, per the color-blind-safe rule below.

tokens.name: secondary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover-only highlight for a primary button's border (never used as a fill).

tokens.name: secondary-tint
tokens.usage: Background tint for a 'complete' row or input — paired with a 1.5px solid secondary border, never alone.

tokens.name: secondary-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Fill for the chip-accent badge (deck-name badges on Manutenção).

tokens.name: secondary-border-soft
tokens.usage: Border for the chip-accent badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Excluir, Substituir tudo), the pendency state, the progress-bar start stop, the error toast, the 'D' quality pill. Never paired with secondary as a status pair by hue alone — see the color-blind-safe note below. 5.1:1 on surface-000, 4.9:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Danger fill on hover/active.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: A warning sentence inside a dark modal, e.g. 'Todos os dados atuais serão substituídos.' — lighter than danger so it reads as prose, not a button.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background tint for a pendency row or input — paired with a 1.5px solid danger border, never alone.

tokens.name: quality-mint
tokens.usage: Quality pill 'M' (Mint) — the green end of the Conversor condition scale.

tokens.name: quality-near-mint
tokens.usage: Quality pill 'NM' (Near Mint).

tokens.name: quality-slightly-played
tokens.usage: Quality pill 'SP' (Slightly Played).

tokens.name: quality-moderately-played
tokens.usage: Quality pill 'MP' (Moderately Played).

tokens.name: quality-heavily-played
tokens.usage: Quality pill 'HP' (Heavily Played).

tokens.name: quality-damaged
tokens.usage: Quality pill 'D' (Damaged) — the red end of the condition scale; aliases danger, the same red used for every other destructive/pendency state.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. Scales down to 20px on narrow pages via clamp(20px,2.4vw,24px) — this token records the desktop size.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Header logotype 'PTCG Tools', beside the two-card logomark. Drop to 15–16px in the mobile sheet and the nav dropdown sample.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph copy — page subtitles, modal body text, textarea content.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row/card titles ('Abra MEG 53'), the deck-name input value, filled-button labels.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Secondary UI text — ghost-button labels, nav-dropdown items, quality/language pill labels, table-input values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badge text, the pendency/success feedback line, the 'Decks:' / 'Precisa:' micro-labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a title — the progress-bar caption 'Progresso do deck', a reference-board frame label.

styles.name: eyebrow-wordmark
styles.usage: The uppercase 'PTCG Tools' eyebrow on documentation/reference boards (Navegação, Feedback).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest stack gap — eyebrow-to-title in a page header block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in a badge or toast; row-card internal micro-stack (title to 'Decks:' line).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table-cell right padding; quality-pill row gap; button-group content padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon+label gap in a nav-link or ghost button; language/quality pill gap; standard input padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row gap inside a maintenance category list; the action-button gap in a modal; a row's own right-side control gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel internal vertical stack gap; modal padding; DeckEditor table-row gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Default input/button horizontal padding; card-row padding; standard page-level flex gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding (Manutenção/DeckEditor category cards).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Header horizontal padding (desktop lower bound); grid gap on the Feedback reference board.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page section gap; grid gap between DeckEditor/Manutenção panels.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Gap between reference frames on a documentation board.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the Decklist column and the Qualidade/Idioma column on Conversor.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: Outer padding on a full-bleed reference/documentation canvas.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The smallest icon-only button — 'add card' in a DeckEditor panel header.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, table-cell inputs, compact icon buttons (remove-row), the deck-name field.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Standard buttons, button-groups, quality pills, language pills, toasts. Always LESS rounded than the panel that holds it — never match a control's radius to its container's.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating menus — the 'Dados' dropdown panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Reference-board device frame (the desktop-nav sample container on the Navegação board).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Standard panel/card — every DeckEditor and Manutenção category card.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: The modal card.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: The mobile navigation sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips/badges, the quality and language pills, the toggle track and knob.

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: The 'Dados' nav dropdown panel.

tokens.name: shadow-mobile-nav
tokens.usage: The mobile navigation sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: The modal card.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Every toast notification.
